coordinatorPublication.provenance: Remote identity supplied by coordinator after its GitHub verification; this lane independently reads the local tree and compares the supplied tree value.

numerics.scope: Independent arithmetic/coverage/causality oracles on actual product modules, fixed archives and bounded generated inputs; not a universal floating-point proof or predictive-validation certificate.

market.binding: Covered controller SHA-256 is 978ad14a70fdb3011f0761ceb7c6f6ebc0d37bc0b25aa047ad2ef2014eff07d6; its sources, model/configurations and 32-case tests are unchanged by the final commit. Source receipt and after-verification hashes bind the run.

replay.method: Execute actual JavaScript controller and coordinator; exhaustive finite command traces plus targeted async ownership, saved-entry, destroy-during-save cases and isolated real-source negative controls

selection.scope: Actual coordinator and controller with deterministic DOM, source, forecast and renderer doubles; exhaustive bounded traces without state merging

refresh.reason: The unchanged model and settings are preserved every 30 completed observation rows. Earlier records remain immutable; observations, evaluation and active experiments continue to refresh daily.

performance.scope: Deterministic renderer/search/selection checks; Node SVG boundary, not browser paint or input-latency measurement.

sourceAfterVerification.scope: Exact working-file SHA-256 equality after both final regression lanes. Protected input bytes also matched the integrated main baseline before execution.

fixtureRepairs.initialFailure: A literal regex required the comparison-header selector to be last in the shared sticky selector list.
fixtureRepairs.correction: Parse exact membership in a flat selector list; preserve position:sticky, top:0, independent viewport and pinned identity assertions.
fixtureRepairs.qualification: Source contract check; browser layout is independently verified by native browser lane.

fixtureRepairs.initialFailure: Production lab-view initialization references MutationObserver, absent in the intentionally inert VM browser boundary.
fixtureRepairs.correction: Provide inert observe/disconnect alongside existing inert ResizeObserver; retain exact production controller and numerical assertion bodies.
fixtureRepairs.after: Complete actual-controller cycle-table integration and full numerical aggregate passed.
fixtureRepairs.qualification: No claim that inert observers verify real mutation, focus or scroll behavior.

limits: Finite arithmetic, lifecycle and source-identity checks do not prove market predictability, calibrated forecast probabilities or profitability.
Performance receipt is deterministic work/DOM/selection verification, not measured native paint or input latency.
This lane does not replace native layout/browser, PostgreSQL service, remote CI or served publication verification.
The old partial unit attempts are intentionally interrupted, never counted as passes.
Existing ETH empirical conditions are recorded separately in remaining-conditions.json; neither historical receipt counts nor old Draft/schedule statements are treated as live remote status.
